Gemma's post-attention and post-feedforward RMSNorms mean that a sublayer's write along a residual direction d equals the component of its pre-norm output along d ⊙ (1+w), divided by the RMS. So "remove or reverse direction d in this layer's output" can be built exactly at the pre-norm level by projecting d ⊙ (1+w) out of o_proj or down_proj.
